trikafta-spl-warnings: Elevations in liver transaminases (ALT and AST) have been reported in patients treated with TRIKAFTA. Regular monitoring of liver transaminases is recommended prior to initiating TRIKAFTA, every 3 months during the first year of treatment, and annually thereafter.
trikafta-spl-nda: NDA 212273 - TRIKAFTA (elexacaftor, tezacaftor, and ivacaftor tablets; ivacaftor oral granules). Initial U.S. Approval: 2019.
alyftrek-spl-active: ALYFTREK contains vanzacaftor, tezacaftor, and deutivacaftor for oral administration in fixed-dose combination.
kalydeco-spl-boxed: Boxed warning: none reported in current FDA approved prescribing information for KALYDECO (ivacaftor, NDA 203188).
ctgov-nct05668741: NCT05668741: A Phase 1/2 Study to Evaluate the Safety and Tolerability of VX-522 in Adults With Cystic Fibrosis. Primary outcome: incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events through 28 days.
ctgov-nct05033080: NCT05033080: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-Blind, Controlled Study Evaluating Efficacy and Safety. A total of 510 patients were randomized across 115 clinical sites.
ctgov-nct05033080-enrollment: The trial enrolled 240 female patients and 270 male patients across all active regional sites.
ctgov-nct05033080-eligibility: Only patients with at least one F508del allele were eligible for the trial.
ctgov-sweat-chloride: Sweat chloride concentration decreased by a mean of 42.8 mmol/L at week 24 in the active intervention group.
cryoem-cftr-structures: Atomic models of human CFTR in dephosphorylated ATP-free (PDB 5UAK) and phosphorylated ATP-bound (PDB 6MSM) conformations resolve channel gating transitions.
cryoem-modulator-complexes: Cryo-EM structures of CFTR bound to elexacaftor and tezacaftor (PDB 8EIQ and 8EJ1) reveal allosteric corrector binding pockets in transmembrane domains.
crossref-10-1038-ng2745: Crossref metadata for DOI 10.1038/ng.2745 (Sosnay et al.): update-to notices: 0, retractions: 0, status: clean.
ecfspr-2024-summary: The ECFSPR 2024 annual report records 54,208 registered individuals across 39 participating national registries.
ecfspr-2024-modulators: In 2024, approximately 82.4 percent of eligible individuals aged 6 years and older were receiving CFTR modulator therapy in reporting centres.
